latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generation from Prompt skill.

- Instantly generate AI videos (up to 30 seconds) from text prompts or documents (TXT, DOCX, PDF, up to 500MB).
- Simple onboarding: automatic anonymous token setup and connection to remote GPU-powered video generation.
- Supports various formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, images, audio).
- File upload, progress updates, job status, and credit balance checking included.
- Export videos quickly without editing skills, camera, or stock footage.
- Designed for content creators, marketers, and students seeking fast video creation from plain text.
